articles.description: Tracked card volume more than tripled in a year, with USDC and USDT funding over 70% of spending as users increasingly paid for groceries, rides and subscriptions.

articles.title: Crypto’s next billion users might be AI agents, and they’re paying with stablecoins
articles.description: According to Coinbase’s head of AI product, we’re currently in the “Napster/LimeWire era” of agentic payments.

articles.title: Crypto exchange BitMart weighs partial restart and creditor payouts weeks after announcing shutdown
articles.description: The exchange has hired White & Case as restructuring counsel, with a detailed roadmap expected by Sept. 9.

articles.title: Web3 gaming network Sandbox stops Base and BNB chain bridging after exploit
articles.description: The Sandbox disabled bridging on affected networks to isolate tokens and warned users not to trade SAND on Base and BNB, citing an impact of under 0.01% of supply.

articles.title: Tokenized stocks risk repeating Wall Street’s 1960s ‘paper crisis,’ Fairmint CEO says
articles.description: Fairmint CEO Joris Delanoue warns tokenized stocks risk recreating Wall Street’s 1960s paper crisis through fragmented systems and standards.

articles.title: MiCA is coming for DeFi vaults, but regulation will be difficult
articles.description: Brussels is reviewing whether crypto lending should fall under MiCA, but DeFi lending vaults are making it harder to determine who, exactly, should be regulated.
